tomsstoragesearchcache.config.title: Tom's Simple Storage search cache fix
tomsstoragesearchcache.config.cacheSecon: How long an unused item tooltip stays cached for terminal search.
Higher = fewer tooltip rebuilds while typing. Results are identical.
tomsstoragesearchcache.config.terminalSy: How often EMI rechecks what you can craft while a storage terminal is open.
Higher = less lag; craftables may appear up to this long after an item does.
50 = EMI default. Other screens are not affected. Applies immediately.
tomsstoragesearchcache.config.skipUnchan: In a storage terminal, EMI only rechecks craftables after the item list,
your inventory or the crafting grid changed. Same results, much less lag.
